'''Decorative Varactyl Egg Nog''' was a beverage that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. As indicated by the name, it was made from the finest Varactyl eggs. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] investigated a case of missing [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] candy for the [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Saun Dann]]. Dann rewarded the spacer with a choice between a decorative egg nog and a [[Decorative Fruitcake|Decorative Fruit Cake]].
